aura: Kesan kuasa dari aksi fisik/atribut: create sea storm, physical waves,driving rain,wind (juno-c17), bukan aura generik.

Sospita form c10/c28; face age/jaw editorial variation.

MOOD: overwhelming imposing majesty and determined expression, active awe inspiring presence, never ordinary or decorative; respectful living religious deity if applicable.
